Start with free tools like GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. By this afternoon, you can have a live store selling ebooks, courses, or templates to international buyers without relying on platforms that reject your region.

content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

In one afternoon, you can deploy a fully operational digital product store that accepts crypto payments from anywhere in the world. Start by setting up a GitHub Pages site for hosting your storefront. Use Google Apps Script to handle backend logic like order processing. Integrate NOWPayments to accept USDT on Tron, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. Load your first three products into the system and configure automatic file delivery via Google Drive. By the end of the day, you’ll have a live store that bypasses geographic payment restrictions and gives you full control over your infrastructure.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The core stack requires four components: hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. Use GitHub Pages for free hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, NOWPayments for crypto payments, and Google Drive for file delivery. This combination is free to set up and requires no subscriptions. It’s designed to work in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. The stack is lightweight, fast to deploy, and fully owned by you. Once live, it operates without dependence on third-party platforms, ensuring your store remains functional even if payment processors restrict your region further.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what’s essential to get your first sale. Skip custom domain setup, advanced analytics, and email marketing integrations for now. These can be added later. Prioritize getting your products live and your payment system operational. Use Binance P2P to convert crypto earnings into naira, cedis, or Kenyan shillings if needed. Avoid over-engineering your stack—start with the minimum viable configuration and iterate based on actual customer behavior. Speed is the priority today, not perfection.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10—ideal for fast, low-cost transactions.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

Test your stack by purchasing a product from your own store using USDT on Tron. Verify that the payment confirms in under 60 seconds and that the file is delivered automatically. Use NOWPayments’ webhook feature to trigger file delivery the moment payment is confirmed on-chain. Once you confirm the process works, share your store link with your audience. Include clear instructions on how to pay using USDT on Tron, emphasizing the low fees and fast settlement. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works and gives you a blueprint for scaling.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

After deploying your stack, focus on driving traffic to your store. Share your link on social media, forums, and email lists. Highlight that your store accepts crypto payments and delivers products instantly. Monitor your NOWPayments dashboard for incoming transactions and ensure file delivery is working flawlessly. If you encounter issues, use the 30-day support included with the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) to resolve them quickly. In the next 24 hours, your goal is to process at least one real customer transaction and gather feedback to refine your stack.

It’s an instant download available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Whether you’re selling ebooks in Nigeria, courses in Ghana, or templates in Kenya, this kit provides the infrastructure to accept international crypto payments without relying on restricted platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up a GitHub Pages site for your storefront. 2. Write backend logic using Google Apps Script to process orders. 3. Integrate NOWPayments to accept USDT on Tron. 4. Configure Google Drive for automatic file delivery. 5. Load your first three products into the system. 6. Test the stack by purchasing a product from your own store. 7. Share your store link with your audience and include payment instructions. 8. Monitor transactions and file deliveries for 24 hours. 9. Use Binance P2P to convert crypto earnings into local currency if needed. 10. Consider upgrading to the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for advanced blueprints and templates.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept payments in local currency using this stack?

The stack accepts USDT on Tron, which you can convert to local currency using Binance P2P. This method supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, giving you flexibility in managing earnings.
How do I handle refunds with crypto payments?
Refunds are processed manually by sending the equivalent USDT back to the buyer’s wallet. Document your refund policy clearly on your store to manage customer expectations.
Is this stack secure for handling customer payments?

The stack uses NOWPayments for secure on-chain payment verification. Since you’re not storing customer payment data, the risk of data breaches is minimized. Focus on securing your own infrastructure access.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes, you can add more products by updating your Google Apps Script and reloading your product list. The stack is designed to scale with your business.
What if I need help during deployment?
